questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All doors are locks.

Some doors are keys.

Conclusions:

(i) Some locks are keys.

(ii) Some keys are doors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52b5a11eaac275828690982fcc417496549fed9d32e19bfe15402b5befe019e5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65ab2c77575e9f19b36a652468dde06b273ec3addc6dec7400b8870947bd64cd.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some locks are keys → **True **(As, All doors are locks, Some doors are keys. so, Some locks are keys holds true)

(ii) Some keys are doors → **True **(As, All doors are locks, Some doors are keys. so, Some keys are doors holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

Seven colleagues (L, M, N, O, P, Q, R) are sitting around a circular meeting table, all facing towards the centre.

O is sitting to the immediate right of L, while P is sitting to the immediate left of L.

questions.question:
2 is related to 9 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 4 is related to 65. To which of the following is 8 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying, etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st³ + 1 = 2nd number.**

2 is related to 9

→ 2³ + 1

→ 8 + 1

→ 9.

4 is related to 65

→ 43 + 1

→ 64 + 1

→ 65.

Similarly,

8 is related to

→ 83 + 1

→ 512 + 1

→ 513.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

102 − 36 + 59 ÷ 4 × 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f54f1652491e4857253279999a4bdd3795f0bb021d09dc459c1045d345bc4fa2.png] 

According to the question, the signs are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Symbol
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 New Symbol
 −
 +
 ÷
 ×
 
 

Now,

Given e×pression: 102 − 36 + 59 ÷ 4 × 2 = ?

After interchanging the specified signs:

⇒ 102 + 36 − 59 × 4 ÷ 2

Perform operations according to BODMAS

⇒ 102 + 36 − __**59 × 4**__ ÷ 2

⇒ 102 + 36 − __**236 ÷ 2**__

⇒ __**102 + 36**__ − 118

⇒ __**138 − 118**__

⇒ 20

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
11 is related to 57 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 14 is related to 72. To which of the following is 17 related, following the same logic?

[NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 12 - Operations on 12 such as addition/subtraction/multiplication to 12 are to be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: 1st number × 5 + 2 = 2nd number.**

11 is related to 57

→ 11 × 5 + 2

→ 55 + 2

→ 57.

And, 

14 is related to 72.

→ 14 × 5 + 2

→ 70 + 2

→ 72.

Similarly,

17 is related to

→ 17 × 5 + 2

→ 85 + 2

**→ 87.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
